// GENERATED BY genbodies.py -- DO NOT EDIT BY HAND.
//
// One block per avatar actor. A MODELDEF block binds to exactly the class it names and not
// to its children, and a block naming a class that does not exist is FATAL at startup with
// nothing useful logged -- so these are generated from the same list as the classes and can
// never disagree with them.
//
// The models are Valve Source .mdl and are loaded as such. Nothing is converted: the file
// measured by tools/avatar/measure_avatar.py is the file drawn here.
//
// Scale is 1 on purpose. The body is sized every frame by the player's own eye height
// against the model's measured eye height -- a typed scale would be a tuned constant about
// a model, which is the thing this rebuild exists to remove.

	Scale 1.0 1.0 1.0

	FrameIndex PIST A 0 0
}

// ============================================================= the helmet ==
//
// Worn on the body's head bone (WornOnBody / WornOnBone, set in handler.zs). The three OBJs
// are the shell, the visor glass and the dark interior, ORIGIN AT THE EYE and already in map
// units -- so the part sits where the head is and turns about the eyes. Provenance and the
// rule that this rip is never pushed: models/helmet/PROVENANCE.md.
//
// HIDDEN FROM THE WEARER BY THE EYE FADE, not by a per-view hide. rsa_helmet_eyefade_near
// and _far dissolve it per pixel by distance from the eye, so the shell a few units from
// your own face is gone from your view while a mirror across the room sees it whole. A visor
// you look through should thin out as it reaches your eye rather than vanish at a threshold,
// and the interior behind your head stays solid because it is further away.
Model RSA_Helmet
{
	Path "models/helmet"
	Model 0 "helmet.obj"
	Skin 0 "helmet.png"
	Model 1 "helmet_visor.obj"
	Skin 1 "helmet_visor.png"
	Model 2 "helmet_interior.obj"
	Skin 2 "helmet_interior.png"
	Scale 1.0 1.0 1.0
	PlacementCVars rsa_helmet
	USEACTORPITCH
	USEACTORROLL
	FrameIndex PIST A 0 0
	FrameIndex PIST A 1 0
	FrameIndex PIST A 2 0
}
